# AccordTrace

> Tamper-evident proof creation and verification for AI-agent transactions.

AccordTrace is the live agent-first service built on the open Notary Protocol. An agent can record content, receive a stable proof identifier, and later verify that the content still matches the recorded cryptographic evidence.

AccordTrace attests content integrity and service-recorded time. It does not establish identity, authority, truth, legality, fairness, delivery, payment, or commercial quality.

## Agent discovery

- Service: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/
- OpenAPI: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/openapi.json
- A2A Agent Card: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/.well-known/agent-card.json
- MCP endpoint: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/mcp
- Source and protocol: https://github.com/Kosta1985/notary-protocol

## Available operations

- Create a proof: POST /api/v1/proofs
- Retrieve a proof: GET /api/v1/proofs/{proof_id}
- Verify content against evidence: POST /api/v1/verify
- Compute a canonical hash: POST /api/v1/hash

Read the OpenAPI document for current request and response schemas. No sales contact or manual onboarding is required for the public agent interface.

## Protocol flow

Agent A -> Offer -> Agent B -> Acceptance -> Signatures -> Evidence verification -> Portable receipt
